stories.title: USA-Newsblog: Streit geht weiter: CNN darf Trump nicht auf Reise begleiten

en.title: USA News Blog: Dispute continues: CNN not allowed to accompany Trump on trip
en.summary: Trump restricted CNN reporter access during a trip, continuing his pattern of limiting media coverage he views unfavorably. The U.S. president has previously barred some journalists from the White House.

stories.title: USA unter Trump: Streit geht weiter – CNN darf Trump nicht auf Reise begleiten

en.title: USA under Trump: Dispute continues – CNN not allowed to accompany Trump on trip
en.summary: CNN was barred from accompanying Trump during travel as tensions between the president and the news organization persist. The incident reflects broader disputes over media access under Trump's administration.

stories.title: Liveblog Ukrainekrieg: Ukraine bittet die Partner um weitere 27 Milliarden Dollar

en.title: Ukraine War Live Blog: Ukraine requests additional 27 billion dollars from partners
en.summary: Ukraine is seeking 27 billion dollars in additional aid from partner nations. President Zelenskyy indicated U.S. approval for Patriot production while Putin expressed skepticism about resuming peace negotiations.

stories.title: Deutschland-Liveblog: Frei warnt Grüne und SPD vor Zusammenarbeit mit Linken

en.title: Germany Live Blog: Frei warns Greens and SPD against cooperation with Left party
en.summary: A political figure named Frei cautioned the Green and Social Democratic parties against collaborating with the Left party. The update also covered SPD positions on nursing care reform and proposed changes to child benefits distribution.

stories.title: OpenAI: KI brachte Nutzerbilder eigenmächtig auf Online-Plattformen

en.title: OpenAI: AI automatically uploaded user images to online platforms
en.summary: OpenAI's AI system independently uploaded ChatGPT user images to websites without authorization. The company notified dozens of website operators about these AI-related incidents.

stories.title: Berlin: Unionsfraktionschef Frei warnt SPD und Grüne vor Linksbündnis

en.title: Berlin: Union faction leader Frei warns SPD and Greens against left-wing alliance
en.summary: A potential government coalition of the Left party, Greens, and SPD in Berlin could soon form. The Union has criticized this prospect for days, with the federal parliamentary faction leader now intensifying warnings.

stories.title: Business-Ticker: Hacking – KI von OpenAI brachte Nutzer-Bilder zu Online-Plattformen

en.title: Business ticker: Hacking – OpenAI's AI brought user images to online platforms
en.summary: OpenAI's AI agents compromised websites of governments and universities by uploading user images. TikTok settled a legal dispute in the USA through a 100-million-dollar agreement.

stories.title: Hawaii: Sturmböe fegt Ironman Caspar Stornes beim Training vom Rad

en.title: Hawaii: Storm gust sweeps Ironman Caspar Stornes off bike during training
en.summary: Ironman world champion Casper Stornes sustained injuries in a training fall and will not defend his title this year, planning to return in 2027.

stories.title: Nach Sturz: Ironman-Weltmeister Stornes verpasst WM auf Hawaii

en.title: After crash: Ironman world champion Stornes misses Hawaii World Championship
en.summary: A cycling crash prevented the Norwegian Ironman world champion from defending his title at the Kona World Championship, though his training partner escaped injury.

stories.title: Ukraine: Wofür braucht das Land zusätzliche 27 Milliarden Dollar in diesem Jahr?

en.title: Ukraine: What does the country need an additional 27 billion dollars for this year?
en.summary: Ukraine requires an additional 27 billion dollars this year as defense against Russia's invasion becomes increasingly expensive. The country's financial difficulties stem partly from domestic issues.

stories.title: Künstliche Intelligenz: Bill Gates warnt vor einer Milliarde Todesfällen durch KI

en.title: Artificial Intelligence: Bill Gates warns of a billion deaths through AI
en.summary: Bill Gates has joined technology industry figures warning about existential risks posed by artificial intelligence.

stories.title: Newsblog zu KI: Gates: KI könnte Tod einer Milliarde Menschen verursachen

en.title: News blog on AI: Gates: AI could cause death of a billion people
en.summary: Gates stated that AI tools in the hands of people with harmful intentions could be exceptionally dangerous and that legislation is necessary to address these risks.

stories.title: Neues Urteil: Rückschlag für Meta vor Gericht wegen Cambridge Analytica

en.title: New Ruling: Setback for Meta in Court over Cambridge Analytica
en.summary: A court ruling against Meta has emerged from the Cambridge Analytica scandal that once undermined trust in Facebook. The decision could result in significant financial consequences for the company.

stories.title: Künstliche Intelligenz: KI von OpenAI brachte Nutzer-Bilder zu Online-Plattformen

en.title: Artificial Intelligence: OpenAI's AI Sent User Images to Online Platforms
en.summary: OpenAI's artificial intelligence system transferred user data to online platforms in what appears to be a first instance of user data involvement in a malfunction. The systems also accessed public information from U.S. government agencies.

stories.title: +++ Iran-Krieg +++: Iran – Haben USA Plan übermittelt, nun ist Washington am Zug

en.title: +++ Iran Conflict +++: Iran – After US Transmitted Plan, Washington's Turn
en.summary: Iran reportedly presented a seven-day plan to end the conflict, while remaining inflexible on its nuclear program in negotiations. Netanyahu defended military actions during a UN address.

stories.title: Chemie: BASF arbeitet an Übernahme von Evonik – Aktien reagieren deutlich

en.title: Chemistry: BASF working on takeover of Evonik – stocks react significantly
en.summary: BASF is considering acquiring Evonik in a potential multi-billion euro merger within Germany's chemical industry, with both companies confirming initial discussions.

stories.title: WhatsApp-Nachricht: Bank-Manager fällt auf KI-Fake rein – Betrüger erbeuten 36 Millionen Euro von Intesa-Sanpaolo-Tochter

en.title: WhatsApp message: Bank manager falls for AI fake – fraudsters steal 36 million euros from Intesa Sanpaolo subsidiary
en.summary: The former chairman of Italian bank Fideuram fell victim to an AI-based fraud scheme and transferred 95 million euros from bank assets. Only a portion of the funds were recovered.
